label: Flat vector
summary: Clean geometric explainer look, no outlines, bold flat colour
history: The modern corporate explainer look popularised by product and edtech videos.
look: Clean geometric shapes, no outlines, bold flat colour and simple dot eyes — the modern explainer look.

line.quality: Shapes are defined by colour alone

composition.focalPoint: Subject on a rule-of-thirds line with data or icons opposite
composition.framing: Wide and tidy, lots of alignment
composition.negativeSpace: Large clean areas for text and charts

dos: Use the saffron accent for one key thing per scene
donts: More than two accent colours at once

generation.description: Clean geometric illustrations using simple shapes, solid colors and minimal details.
generation.visualIdentity: Modern minimal flat vector graphic design.
generation.linework: Clean geometric edges with minimal or no outlines.
generation.textures: Flat solid fills with very limited gradients and almost no surface texture.
generation.characters: Simplified geometric human figures with minimal facial details and recognizable silhouettes.
generation.backgrounds: Minimal buildings, geometric trees, hills, roads, clouds and simple landscapes.
generation.lighting: Minimal lighting with subtle directional shadows.
generation.composition: Balanced geometric layouts, clear spacing and simple visual hierarchy.
generation.instructions: Create a clean flat vector illustration using geometric shapes, solid fills, minimal details and consistent proportions. Maintain a limited palette across scenes.
generation.promptModifier: Render as clean modern flat vector artwork using geometric shapes, simplified silhouettes, solid color fills, minimal details, crisp edges, balanced spacing and a limited harmonious color palette. Use minimal shadows and clean graphic design principles.
generation.negativePrompt: Photorealistic rendering, heavy textures, complex gradients, realistic shadows, noisy backgrounds, excessive details.
generation.negativeModifier: Photorealism, painterly brush strokes, heavy textures, complex gradients, excessive shadows, noisy details.
